## Passages
RESULT [labelnoise]: Beat seven competing noisy-label methods on CIFAR. On ImageNet it quantified ontological overlap, for example about 645 'missile' images labelled as the parent class 'projectile'.
US [labelnoise]: The confident joint is the right diagnostic for a systematic class permutation like the cwd12 id-to-species error. A source dataset whose confident joint against cwd12 prototypes is concentrated off the diagonal was mapped wrongly as a whole and should be rejected or remapped as a unit, not cleaned box by box. This principle already underlies dino_label_verifier.py.
CORRECTION [labelnoise]: Confirmed: JAIR 70 (2021). CL beats seven methods on CIFAR and estimates 645 missile images mislabeled as the parent class 'projectile' in ImageNet.
